data.text: 0.8.0 verified from the registry (latest=0.8.0, provenance in sigstore): clean npm i in a throwaway dir, init wrote .claude/settings.json with SessionStart and UserPromptSubmit, prime listed the decision, search and hook prompt both returned it. One question with a verb the record lacks ('why did we choose postgres') got nothing from either: the lexical limit DEC-28 names, not a hook fault. A first smoke test looked like the hook going silent; it was the test reusing one session id, so once-per-session did its job.
